scenario: LIMP.5.1.5 — class 2 collision: two imports bringing in the same unit symbol from different libraries rejects with DS_VALIDATE_UNIT_IMPORT_COLLISION, even where both declare the same conversion. The validator detects when imported_unit_symbol_origins[name] disagrees with the new import's library_name and surfaces the conflict before letting the second import silently overwrite the first. The symbol is `celsius`, a derived unit on `units.core`'s `temperature`.
rules_ds:
from lib_a import celsius
from lib_b import celsius
